summary: This is a Form 8-K filed by Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Securities, Inc., as depositor, reporting the issuance of BANK5 2026-5YR22 Commercial Mortgage Pass-Through Certificates. The registrant sold $735.8M publicly offered and $96.8M privately offered certificates to underwriters. The filing covers a routine securitization under a pooling and servicing agreement, with underwriting details and legal opinions. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or activist campaign is involved; it is a standard asset-backed securities issuance.
